name: reelearn
description: Learn anything as short-form reels. Cloudflare Pages + Workers monorepo.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @reelearn/api" "npm run dev -w @reelearn/web"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:web
